statBlock.name: Skulk
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Travelers lost in the Shadowfell can lose their sense of self and become invisible skulks.

sections.Traits:
Fallible Invisibility. The skulk is invisible. Light from a candle made with the rendered fat of an unidentified corpse reveals it as a dim, translucent figure. Humanoid children age 10 or younger can see it. A mirror or other reflective surface reveals its reflection as a drab, smooth-skinned biped.
Trackless. The skulk leaves no tracks to mark its path or direction.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.
sections.Summoning mechanics: A ritual can call a skulk from the Shadowfell. For 30 days it obeys the summoner and, when visible, looks vaguely like them. It can return to the Shadowfell only when it dies.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 219.

statBlock.name: Skull Lord
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Three treacherous leaders share one body. Skull lords command undead armies in the Shadowfell and scheme against each other even while bound together.

sections.Languages: All languages it knew in life.
sections.Damage resistances: Cold, necrotic, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, poisoned, stunned, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Evasion. If a Dexterity save would halve damage, success prevents all damage and failure halves it, provided the skull lord isn't incapacitated.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). When the skull lord fails a save, it can use one charge to succeed instead.
Master of the Grave. Undead allies within 30 ft. have advantage on saves. An Undead ally that starts its turn there regains 1d6 hit points.
Unusual Nature. The skull lord needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three attacks with Bone Staff or Deathly Ray.
Bone Staff. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.
Deathly Ray. Ranged spell attack, +10 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (5d8 + 5) necrotic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 18).
At will. Mage Hand, Message.
2/day each. Dimension Door, Fear.
1/day each. Cloudkill, Cone of Cold.
sections.Legendary actions:
The skull lord has 3 legendary actions and regains them at the start of its turn. Spend the stated cost on one option immediately after another creature's turn. The skull lord cannot use them while incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it must finish its first turn before using one.
Attack (1 action). Make one Bone Staff or Deathly Ray attack.
Move (1 action). Move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Summon Undead (2 actions). Summon up to five skeletons or zombies in unoccupied spaces within 30 ft. They roll initiative and act on the next available turn. They obey the skull lord and remain until destroyed. The skull lord can have at most five Undead from this ability at once.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 220.

statBlock.name: Slithering Tracker
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A person bent on revenge can undergo a ritual that leaves their mind inside a living puddle. The resulting ooze tastes the ground as it follows its quarry.

sections.Languages: Understands the languages it knew in its previous form but can't speak.
sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, deafened, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. If motionless when combat starts, the tracker has advantage on initiative. A creature that hasn't seen the tracker move or act must pass a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize it as a creature rather than a puddle.
Liquid Form. The tracker may enter and stop in an enemy's space. It can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Spider Climb. The tracker can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
Life Leech. Choose one Large or smaller creature the tracker can see within 5 ft. It makes a DC 13 Dexterity save. On a failure, it is grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, it is restrained and cannot breathe unless it can breathe water. It takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The tracker can grapple one target at a time. While the grapple lasts, the tracker takes half any damage dealt to it (round down), and the target takes the rest.
sections.Bonus actions: Watery Stealth. While underwater, take the Hide action and make the Dexterity (Stealth) check with advantage.
sections.Creation ritual: Hags, liches, and priests of gods of vengeance know the ritual. It requires a willing creature driven by revenge. The ritual drains the creature's moisture and kills its body. Its mind persists as the tracker.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 221.

statBlock.name: Spawn of Kyuss
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Green worms infest this undead creature. The priest Kyuss created the first spawn in service to Orcus, and the worms spread the curse to new hosts.

sections.Languages: Understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. At the start of its turn, the spawn regains 10 hit points if it has at least 1 hit point and is outside sunlight and running water. Acid, fire, or radiant damage prevents regeneration at the start of its next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
Worms. An effect that cures disease or removes a curse kills the spawn's worms and removes its Burrowing Worm action.
Unusual Nature. The spawn needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and use Burrowing Worm if available.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.
Burrowing Worm. Launch a worm at one Humanoid the spawn can see within 10 ft. The worm attaches unless the target passes a DC 11 Dexterity save. The spawn can launch a scraped-off worm at a visible Humanoid within 10 ft. of that worm.
sections.Burrowing worm mechanics: The worm is a Tiny Undead with AC 6, 1 hit point, a speed of 1 ft., and a score of 2 (−4) in every ability. A worm on the skin can be killed normally or scraped off as an action. If it remains, it burrows at the end of the target's next turn and deals 1 piercing damage. At the end of each of the target's turns after that, it takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage per worm, up to 10d6 total. If this reduces the target to 0 hit points, it dies and rises 10 minutes later as a spawn of Kyuss. An effect that cures disease or removes a curse kills all worms infesting the target.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 225.

statBlock.name: Spirit Troll
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: A troll struck by psychic energy can regenerate as a shadowy form. It still bites and claws, but its attacks strike the mind.

sections.Damage immunities: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Incorporeal Movement. The troll can move through creatures and objects as difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
Regeneration. The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. Psychic or force damage prevents regeneration at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Claws attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage. The target must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save or be stunned for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the stun on a success.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 247.

statBlock.name: Spring Eladrin
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Spring eladrin express the energy and delight of new growth. Their presence can leave other creatures enchanted.

sections.Traits:
Joyful Presence. A creature other than an eladrin that starts its turn within 60 ft. makes a DC 16 Wisdom save. On a failure, the eladrin charms it for 1 minute. On a success, it becomes immune to any eladrin's Joyful Presence for 24 hours. Whenever the eladrin damages the charmed creature, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.
Magic Resistance. The eladrin has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks with Longsword or Longbow. Spellcasting can replace one attack.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage with one hand or 7 (1d10 + 2) with two hands. Either grip adds 22 (5d8) psychic damage.
Longbow. Ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 22 (5d8) psychic damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 16) and no material components.
At will. Tasha's Hideous Laughter.
1/day each. Major Image, Suggestion.
sections.Bonus actions: Fey Step (Recharge 4–6). Teleport up to 30 ft. to an unoccupied space the eladrin can see. Anything it wears or carries goes with it.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 116.
sections.Changeable Natures mechanics: After finishing a long rest, an eladrin that is not incapacitated can adopt another season's stat block. Carry over its damage taken, conditions, and other ongoing effects.

statBlock.name: Star Spawn Grue
statBlock.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
statBlock.description: Grues swarm ahead of more powerful star spawn. Their shrieks unsettle creatures nearby and draw attention away from their allies.

sections.Traits: Aura of Shrieks. Creatures within 20 ft. that aren't Aberrations have disadvantage on saving throws and on attack rolls against any creature other than a star spawn grue.
sections.Actions: Confounding Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage. The target must pass a DC 10 Wisdom save or attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of the grue's next turn.
sections.Printed source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse, p. 227.
